notes: Almost no TM hyper-parameters are given: Table I claims identical parameters for HVTM and TM without listing them; no clause counts, T, epochs, splits or seeds. HV size (HVSize) and density (NBits = number of True bits per token) are swept in figures only (values not extractable as text). Results 4 and 10 are the same number (89.67, IMDB HVTM with RbE). The TREC Table I value 95.6 differs from the heatmap best 96.8 (result 11); which setting Table I used is not said. The XOR illustration (Fig. 4) has no numbers. References [14]-[49] are unrelated to the body text (copied bibliography).
